name: LLVM GlobalISel
listed_description: Pass-based global instruction selection framework in LLVM backends; works on whole machine functions instead of building a selection DAG per basic block.
claim_text: Turning extra passes off increases compilation speed while turning them on improves generated code quality; scales as needed (qualitative, no numbers).
found_in: book: Learn LLVM 17, 2nd ed. (2023), ch. 12, Global instruction selection

name: LLVM FastISel
listed_description: Quick instruction selector in LLVM backends used for unoptimized code; generates code fast but of lower quality than SelectionDAG.
claim_text: Can quickly generate code, but generated code is inferior to selection DAG output (qualitative, no numbers).
found_in: book: Learn LLVM 17, 2nd ed. (2023), ch. 12, Instruction selection via the selection DAG
